clinicalReview.initialReview: QMP or supervised physicist before first fraction
clinicalReview.emergencyException: On-call remote/in-person review; if unavailable oncologist initial review followed by QMP next business day or before next treatment that day
clinicalReview.QA: First weekly review checks IMRT QA and documentation were completed prior to first fraction; not permission to defer QA
clinicalReview.changes: Dose-affecting changes handled as new plan review; fraction-only changes require differentiated documented handling

IGRT.onlineOffline: v11 IAEA historical definitions retained: online current fraction vs offline subsequent-fraction strategy; not every IGRT assessment triggers immediate couch shift
